name: Felix Argyle
japaneseName: フェリックス・アーガイル
description: Felix Argyle, commonly known as Ferris, is the personal knight of Crusch Karsten, a member of the Royal Guard, and the greatest water magic healer in the Kingdom of Lugunica. He plays a major role in Arc 3, and supporting roles in Arc 5, Arc 9, and Arc 10.
